title: Sarvam’s Token Factory Raises India’s AI Inference Stakes
summary: Sarvam AI’s latest announcement of its Token Factory has brought a new layer of India’s artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure ecosystem…
llm_summary: Sarvam AI has launched its “Token Factory,” a platform that lets developers mint, manage, and monetize AI inference tokens on a blockchain‑based marketplace. By turning compute power into tradable assets, the service aims to streamline access to scalable AI inference for Indian startups and enterprises, lowering costs and fostering a vibrant AI‑as‑a‑service ecosystem. This move positions India as a key player in the emerging AI‑inference economy.
